verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical: the stack is restructured sensibly for the tall skyscraper format, but in both the Shop Sale button sits only about 10px from each side edge, the lilac circle floats off to the right of the can instead of framing it, the can's label text is unreadably tiny, and the left margin (about 10px) is narrower than the top gap. A sits higher, so the headline is cramped against the top and a large dead gap opens between the can and the 'Ends Sunday' line. B moves everything down, which spreads the vertical space more evenly, so it edges ahead.
